lines.japanese: ブブッブブッブブッ
lines.english: Bzzzt. Bzzzt. Bzzzt.

lines.japanese: 『はい』のボタンを押そうとしたら、急に携帯電話が震えだした。今度はメールじゃない。何度も何度も震えている。
lines.english: Just as I reached for YES, the phone began to vibrate. This time it was not a message. It buzzed again and again.

lines.japanese: 画面には着信者の名前が表示されていた。登録してるひとじゃないと名前は表示されないはずだ。僕は両手で携帯電話を握って覗きこんだ。
lines.english: A caller's name appeared on the screen. A name should appear only for someone in my contacts. I gripped the phone in both hands and peered down.

lines.japanese: 「山科京」
lines.english: ‘Miyako Yamashina’

lines.japanese: 山科さんだ！　さっき、渡来さんの家で駆けつけてくれた彼女の姿を思い出して、僕は息を飲みながら通話ボタンを押した。
lines.english: Yamashina! I remembered her rushing into Watarai's apartment earlier. I caught my breath and pressed the answer button.

lines.japanese: 「もしもし」
lines.english: “Hello?”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君！？」
lines.english: “Haneda?!”

lines.japanese: 「山科さん！」
lines.english: “Yamashina!”

lines.japanese: 間違いなく山科さんの声だった。両手の中にあるケータイを更に強く握りしめる。
lines.english: It was definitely Yamashina's voice. I squeezed the phone even tighter in both hands.

lines.japanese: 「よかった……繋がって。いまどこにいるの？」
lines.english: “Thank goodness... I got through. Where are you?”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええと……」
「いいの、私は羽田君に会いたいだけなの。お願い、一目でいいから羽田君の顔を見せて」
lines.english: “It doesn’t matter. I only want to see you, Haneda. Please. Just let me see your face, even for a moment.”

lines.japanese: 「山科さん……」
lines.english: “Yamashina...”

lines.japanese: 「なにも言わなくていいから……羽田君に……会いたいよ……」
lines.english: “You don't have to say anything... I want... to see you...”

lines.japanese: 電話越しの彼女の声は、ただ切なげに、ひたすらに僕を求めていた。
lines.english: Her voice over the phone sounded so sad, like all she wanted was me.

lines.japanese: 僕の恋人とずっと一緒にいる約束。それが、僕がこの世界に居る理由になるかもしれない。
lines.english: A promise to stay with my girlfriend forever. Maybe that could give me a reason to be in this world.

lines.japanese: 「おれ……逃げてばかりだけど……」
lines.english: “I've done nothing but run away...”

lines.japanese: 「私からは逃げないって言ってくれたよね。だからずっと側に居てくれるよね」
lines.english: “You said you wouldn't run from me. So you'll stay beside me forever, won't you?”

lines.japanese: そうだ、僕よりかわいそうなひとがここに居るんだ。僕の妄想の世界の住人以外で、僕を求めてくれるひと。
lines.english: That's right. There was someone here who was worse off than me. Someone outside my fantasy world who wanted me.

lines.japanese: 「分かった……今すぐ行くよ」
lines.english: “All right... I'll come to you right now.”
“Re... ally?”

lines.japanese: それは、この世界にある言語では表現できない感情だったのかもしれない。嬉しさと、弱さと、愛しさが一つに詰まった感情。
lines.english: Maybe it was a feeling no language in this world could put into words. Happiness, weakness, and tenderness, all packed together.

lines.japanese: 「いまどこにいるの？」
lines.english: “Where are you now?”

lines.japanese: 「さっきのマンションの前……」
lines.english: “Outside the building from before...”

lines.japanese: 「行くよ。今度は逃げない」
lines.english: “I'm coming. This time I won't run.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君……」
lines.english: “Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 「うん、信じてる」
lines.english: “Yeah. I believe you.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんはいつもの彼女を取りもどしていた。
lines.english: Yamashina was her usual self again.

lines.japanese: 彼女の元に行こう。僕は紺色に支配され始めた空の下を駆けだした。
lines.english: I would go to her. Beneath a sky slowly surrendering to navy blue, I began to run.

lines.japanese: 道路は暗かった。
lines.english: The road was dark.

lines.japanese: 冬の夜道に人影は少なく、その場所一帯は時間が止まったかのようにしんとしていた。
lines.english: There were few people out on the winter streets, and the whole area was so quiet it felt like time had stopped.

lines.japanese: 全力で走ってきた。不思議と軽い体は、空気をこぐようにくんと進む。
lines.english: I had run flat out. My strangely weightless body surged onward as though rowing through the air.

lines.japanese: やるべきことは一つ。僕の恋人が待ってくれている。
lines.english: There was only one thing to do. My girlfriend was waiting for me.

lines.japanese: マンションの前に辿りついた僕は、はあっと息を吐いた。内燃機関がどくんと鼓動する。
lines.english: I reached the apartment building and let out a hard breath. My internal-combustion engine gave a heavy thud.

lines.japanese: 何故か気の進めない暗闇をじっと見ていたら、タイル張りのマンションの入り口が開き、中からふらりと人が出てきた。
lines.english: I stared into the darkness, even though something about it bothered me. Then the tiled entrance of the apartment building opened and someone came wandering out.

lines.japanese: おぼつかない足取りで、手を壁に添えながら一歩ずつ歩みよってくる。人気のない街に彼女の衣装は少し滑稽だった。
lines.english: She came toward me one faltering step at a time, one hand trailing along the wall. In the deserted street, her costume looked faintly absurd.

lines.japanese: 「山科さんっ」
lines.english: “Yamashina!”

lines.japanese: 大きな声だ。
lines.english: That was loud.

lines.japanese: 僕は自分の恋人がそこに居ることに、喜びを覚えたんだと思う。
lines.english: I think I was just happy that my girlfriend was there.

lines.japanese: 「んっ……んん、ん……」
「はあっ、はっ、はっ……」
lines.english: “Hah... hah... hah...”

lines.japanese: 山科さん。僕の本当の恋人。
lines.english: Yamashina. My real girlfriend.

lines.japanese: 彼女はなんだか疲れているみたいだった。壁に当てていた左手が滑り、なんとか下半身だけで状態を整える。足元には大量の錠剤やカプセルが散らばっていた。
lines.english: She looked exhausted. Her left hand slipped down the wall, and somehow she managed to steady herself with her legs alone. Pills and capsules littered the ground at her feet.

lines.japanese: 「上がらない……上がらないよう……なんでリタ規制しちゃったんだよう……」
lines.english: “I can’t get high... I just can’t get high... Why’d they have to crack down on Ritalin...?”

lines.japanese: 荒い息遣いの中には、嗚咽のような音が入りまじって聞こえた。
lines.english: I could hear something like sobbing mixed in with her ragged breaths.

lines.japanese: 「あたま、痛い……は、はははネ、羽田君、羽田君、どこ……」
lines.english: “My head hurts... H-ha ha ha—Haneda? Haneda, where are you...?”

lines.japanese: あれ、おかしいな。彼女の衣装がさっきよりも紅い。
lines.english: Wait. Something was wrong. Her clothes were redder than before.

lines.japanese: ああ、彼女が滑稽に見えたのは、ただこの場にそぐわないからというだけじゃないんだ。
lines.english: Ah. She hadn't looked ridiculous just because she was out of place here.

lines.japanese: 僕は気がついた。
lines.english: I understood.

lines.japanese: 衣装が、着てるものが変わっていたんだ。さっき渡来さんの家で見た服じゃない。
lines.english: Her clothes—what she was wearing—had changed. They were not the clothes I had seen at Watarai's apartment.

lines.japanese: 彼女が着ている服には、ドス黒い赤のリアルな装飾が施されていた。
lines.english: Her costume bore a horribly lifelike decoration in blackish red.

lines.japanese: 「まだかな……まだ、はねだくん……」
lines.english: “Is he here yet...? Still no Haneda...?”

lines.japanese: 「頭が溶けちゃう……厚生労働省のせいで……このままじゃ保たないよ……空が堕ちてくる……羽田君、はやくきてぇ……」
lines.english: “My brain's melting... It's the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's fault... I can't hold out like this... The sky is falling... Hurry, Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 山科さん、なにがあったんだろう……いつもと雰囲気が違う。なんだか苦しそうだ。
lines.english: What had happened to Yamashina...? Something felt different about her. She looked like she was hurting.

lines.japanese: でも、どんなことがあっても、僕は彼女から逃げないと決めたんだ。彼女はとても優しいひとで、僕の側に居てくれると言ったんだ。
lines.english: But I had decided that whatever happened, I would never run from her. She was a very kind person, and she had said she would stay beside me.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君、捨てないで……ああもう蠅がうるさいなあ……ミサイル食べたい……シュルギン博士が早く新しいの開発してくれないから……」
lines.english: “Don’t abandon me, Haneda... God, these flies are so loud... I want to swallow a missile... Dr. Shulgin needs to hurry up and come up with something new...”

lines.japanese: まだ視点が定まっていない彼女に向けて僕は呼びかけた。
lines.english: I called out to her, though her eyes still would not focus.

lines.japanese: 「山科さん！」
lines.english: “Yamashina!”

lines.japanese: 「見つけた！　羽田君！」
lines.english: “There you are! Haneda!”
“What?”

lines.japanese: ぐりんと首が向いたかと思うと、街灯に照らされて顔色を透明に染めながら、彼女は静かに笑った。
lines.english: Her head swiveled toward me. The streetlamp bleached her face nearly transparent, and she smiled without a sound.

lines.japanese: 「ま、待って。どうしたの山科さん」
lines.english: “W-wait. What's happened to you, Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: どうして僕はこのとき立ちどまってしまったんだろう。彼女から逃げないと決めたはずなのに。
lines.english: Why did I stop walking then? I had decided I would not run from her.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたってなにが？　羽田君のこと探してたんだよ」
lines.english: “What do you mean, what's happened? I was looking for you, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、様子がおかしいっていうか、なんだか疲れてるように見えるよ」
lines.english: “No, I mean... you don't seem like yourself. You look exhausted.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、疲れちゃった。いま切れ目だからね」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I’m tired. It’s wearing off now.”

lines.japanese: 微笑んだままの彼女は頭を押さえる左手はそのままに、もう片方の手を僕に向かって差しだした。
lines.english: Still smiling, she kept her left hand pressed to her head and extended the other hand toward me.

lines.japanese: いや、彼女が見せようとしたものは右手じゃない。その中に握られているものだ。
lines.english: No. It was not her right hand she wanted me to see. It was what she held in it.

lines.japanese: 「な、なにかな、それ……あまり見ないもののような気がするけど」
lines.english: “Wh-what is that...? It doesn’t look like something you see every day.”

lines.japanese: 「これ？　これは医療用メスのパニヒダちゃん。今朝手に入れたばかりなんだよ」
lines.english: “This? This is Panikhida, my surgical scalpel. I only got her this morning.”

lines.japanese: 「医療用なんてよく手に入ったね」
lines.english: “I'm surprised you managed to get a surgical one.”

lines.japanese: 「簡単だよー。使い捨てメスなら、その辺のお店でも売ってるよ。切れ味に良し悪しがあるから、試してみないといけないけどね」
lines.english: “It's easy. You can buy disposable scalpels in ordinary shops. Some are sharper than others, though, so you have to test them.”

lines.japanese: 「試すって……どうやって？」
lines.english: “Test them... how?”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ」
lines.english: “Hehe.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は不思議そうに顔を傾かせて、質問した僕へ問いかえすように笑った。
lines.english: She tilted her head as if puzzled and answered my question with an inquiring smile of her own.

lines.japanese: 「でもこの子は違うよ。前からお世話になってるお店で、特別に売ってもらった本物なの。もう凄い切れ味」
lines.english: “But this girl is different. A shop I've used for ages sold me the genuine article as a special favor. She's unbelievably sharp.”

lines.japanese: 「え……そんな、買ったばかりのものなのに、どうして、切れ味なんて……」
lines.english: “But... if you only bought it this morning, how do you know how sharp it is...?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、でも、羽田君の体に他のひとの血を混ぜるのはイヤだな。ちょっと待ってね、パニヒダちゃんを私の服で拭うから」
lines.english: “Oh, but I don't want to mix somebody else's blood into your body, Haneda. Wait a moment. I'll wipe Panikhida clean on my clothes.”

lines.japanese: 「ほ、他の血ってどういうこと？　誰の血？　それと、おれに混ぜるって？」
lines.english: “Wh-what do you mean, somebody else's blood? Whose blood? And what do you mean, mix it into me?”

lines.japanese: 「ふふふっ」
lines.english: “Hehehe.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は笑うだけで、僕の質問には一つも答えてくれない。
lines.english: She only laughed. She would not answer a single question.

lines.japanese: だけど行かなくちゃ。なぜか足がすくむけど、僕は山科さんの下に行かないといけない。
lines.english: But I had to go. My feet wouldn't move for some reason, but I had to get to Yamashina.

lines.japanese: 「山科さん、おれはもう逃げないって決めたんだ。だから側に居てくれるかな」
lines.english: “I've decided I won't run anymore, Yamashina. So will you stay beside me?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、もちろんだよ。だって羽田君が居なくなったら、私にはなにもなくなっちゃうもん」
lines.english: “Of course. If you disappeared, Haneda, I'd have nothing left at all.”

lines.japanese: 「よかった、じゃあおれのことを許してくれるんだね」
lines.english: “Thank goodness. Then you'll forgive me.”

lines.japanese: 「赦すってなんのこと？　そんなこと私、言ったっけ」
lines.english: “Forgive you for what? Did I say anything about forgiving you?”

lines.japanese: 「あれ」
lines.english: “Wait...”

lines.japanese: そういえば、僕はなにに対して許してもらおうと思ったんだろう。自分でもよく分からない。
lines.english: Come to think of it, what was I even asking her to forgive me for? I wasn't sure myself.

lines.japanese: 「もしかして、私に隠し事なんてしてないよね」
lines.english: “You haven't been keeping secrets from me, have you?”

lines.japanese: 「し、してないよ。山科さんはおれの恋人だもん」
lines.english: “N-no. You're my girlfriend, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「うんうん、そうだよね。ずっと一緒に居てくれるんだもんね」
lines.english: “Mm-hm, exactly. You're going to stay with me forever.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあどうして私を教室に置いていったの」
lines.english: “Then why did you leave me in the classroom?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「放課後に私のこと置いていったよね、ずっと待ってたのに」
lines.english: “You left me there after school. I waited and waited for you.”

lines.japanese: なんのことだろう。僕には思いあたる節がない。
lines.english: What was she talking about? I could think of nothing.

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあさ、これからは毎日一緒に帰ろうよ。うん約束する」
lines.english: “Then from now on, let's walk home together every day. I promise.”

lines.japanese: 「したよー。一番最初にした約束なのに、忘れるなんて酷いな」
lines.english: “You did. It was the very first promise we made. It's so mean of you to forget.”

lines.japanese: 「今日だって、心配して保健室まで見にいったらいないし、嫌な予感がするから探してみれば、渡来さんの家にいるし」
lines.english: “Even today—I was worried, so I went all the way to the nurse's office to check on you, and you weren't there. I had a horrible feeling, and when I went looking, there you were at Watarai's apartment.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、私のこと裏切ったの？」
lines.english: “Did you betray me?”

lines.japanese: 「それは、渡来さんが大事な話があるって言うからだよ。ちょっと話をしに行っただけなんだ」
lines.english: “Watarai said she had something important to tell me. I only went there to talk.”

lines.japanese: 「だーめ」
lines.english: “Nooo.”

lines.japanese: 「私以外の女の子と話しちゃだーめ」
lines.english: “No talking to any girls but me.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、約束する」
lines.english: “A-all right. I promise.”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとに？　もう裏切らない？」
lines.english: “Really? You'll never betray me again?”

lines.japanese: 「裏切ってなんてないよ。おれは、そんなつもりじゃなかったんだ」
lines.english: “I haven't betrayed you. I never meant to do anything like that.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか、そうだよね。羽田君は優しいひとだもんね」
lines.english: “I see. Of course. You're a kind person, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、じゃあ指切りしよっ」
lines.english: “Good. Then let's make a pinkie promise.”

lines.japanese: 彼女が僕に一歩近づいた。何故だろう、僕はそれに合わせて一歩あとずさった。
lines.english: She took one step toward me. For some reason, I matched it with one step back.

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれ？　おかしいな。はは、ごめん、ちょっとおれも疲れてるみたいなんだ」
lines.english: “W-wait. That's strange. Ha ha, sorry. I suppose I'm a little tired too.”

lines.japanese: 前に動こうとした。だけど、体が言うことを聞いてくれない。
lines.english: I tried to step forward. But my body wouldn't do what I told it to.

lines.japanese: 「私のこと裏切ったりしないよね。ずっと一緒に居てくれるんだよね」
lines.english: “You won't betray me, will you? You'll stay with me forever, won't you?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、当たり前じゃない。約束したからね」
lines.english: “Of course. I made you a promise.”

lines.japanese: 彼女がさらに一歩近づいてきた。今度は足を踏んばってなんとか耐えた。
lines.english: She came another step closer. This time I braced my legs and somehow held my ground.

lines.japanese: 「もう、裏切られるのは嫌なんだ」
lines.english: “I don't ever want to be betrayed again.”

lines.japanese: 「重いって言われて、虐げられて、邪魔者扱いされて、何度会おうとしても嫌がられて、向こうは相手を見つけて幸せになって」
lines.english: “Being told I was too much. Being abused and treated like a nuisance. Having him recoil no matter how many times I tried to see him. Then he found somebody else and was happy.”

lines.japanese: 「違うよね、羽田君はそんなことしないよね。私のためなら何でもしてくれるんだよね」
lines.english: “But you're different, aren't you, Haneda? You'd do anything for me, wouldn't you?”

lines.japanese: 「は、はは、何でもとは言えないけど、おれに出来ることならね」
lines.english: “H-ha ha. I can't say I'd do anything, but if it's something I can do...”

lines.japanese: 彼女が胸に手を当てて、ふうっと恍惚とした表情を浮かべる。その目はどこか億劫そうに冬の空を映していた。
lines.english: She put a hand to her chest and let out a long breath, a blissful look on her face. Her eyes reflected the winter sky with a strange weariness.

lines.japanese: 「私ね、前のひとよりも羽田君のことの方がずっとずっとずっと好き。だって、こんな気持ちになったのは、君の方がずっとずっとずっと遥かに強いんだもん」
lines.english: “I love you so, so, so much more than the man before you. Because what I feel for you is so, so, so much stronger.”

lines.japanese: 「山科さん、嬉しいよ」
lines.english: “That makes me happy, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 僕が顔をほころばせるのと同時に、山科さんが目の前に立った。気を抜いていたのか、隙をつかれたからか、冷や汗がぶわっと吹きだすのを感じる。
lines.english: Just as I smiled, Yamashina was standing right in front of me. Maybe I'd relaxed, or maybe she'd caught me off guard. Cold sweat broke out all over me.

lines.japanese: 隙。隙って何だろう。自分でも言っている意味が分からない。彼女の目の中に僕は映っているのか。
lines.english: An opening. What was an opening, anyway? I didn't even know what I meant. Was I even reflected in her eyes?

lines.japanese: 「はい、じゃあ指切り。小指出して」
lines.english: “Okay, then. Pinkie promise. Hold out your pinkie.”

lines.japanese: 彼女が手を出してきた。肌の白い小指がぴんと立っている。
lines.english: She held out her hand. Her pale little finger stood perfectly straight.

lines.japanese: ぎゅっと握られた右手の先で、医療用メスが青い光をきらりと反射していた。
lines.english: The surgical scalpel in her tightly clenched right hand caught the light and flashed blue.

lines.japanese: 僕の頭の中に不思議な映像が浮かんだ。彼女の小指に絡めようとして、自分の小指がいつまでも届かない場面。
lines.english: A strange image rose in my mind: I tried to hook my little finger around hers, but no matter how long I tried, my finger never reached it.
“Ah... ha ha...”

lines.japanese: 僕は小指を伸ばせなかった。何故だろう、山科さんはこんなにもやさしい笑顔を浮かべているというのに。
lines.english: I could not extend my little finger. Why? Yamashina was smiling so gently.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの？　指切りげんまんしようよ」
lines.english: “What's wrong? Let's pinkie swear.”

lines.japanese: 「はは……ええと」
lines.english: “Ha ha... Um...”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの？　できないの？」
lines.english: “What's wrong? Can't you do it?”

lines.japanese: 彼女の幸せそうな笑顔に、僕もできるだけやさしく作った笑顔でうなずいた。
lines.english: I put on the gentlest smile I could and nodded back at her happy face.

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm-hm.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ死ねよ」
lines.english: “Then die.”

lines.japanese: 「あの」
「おまえが厚生労働省か！」
lines.english: “Are you the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare?!”
